title: Bathe in Beauty
coreMove: Beauty restores stillness when you receive a patch of light or art before using it for status, output, or proof; that pause gives the soul room to settle.

exampleSpecs.domain: hardware store key desk wait audit
exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who reviews work logs and needs to notice where beauty changes the experience without becoming a metric
exampleSpecs.stakes: a rushed service line will be treated only as a speed problem unless the audit notices what softens attention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: reviews remake slips and footage at a hardware store key desk, then discovers that natural patterns change the wait

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who turns idle moments into proof and needs to practice receiving beauty before sharing it
exampleSpecs.stakes: the pause will become content unless Amir notices the reflex before the taxi arrives
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: stays inside Amir's thoughts at a taxi stand kiosk as he works through the urge to make beauty perform

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who buys calming products before considering a free change in attention
exampleSpecs.stakes: a small budget will be spent on a fix before Landon names the attention he can give for free
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: deliberates over scarce money and time at a pharmacy aisle endcap, with no execution shown

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who needs beauty in a work room but also has a real deadline
exampleSpecs.stakes: one sheet of paper cannot serve both duty and restoration, so the move must avoid both avoidance and neglect
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: sets one genuine two-bad-options tension at a home office printer tray

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader surrounded by measurement who needs to leave one beautiful minute unscored
exampleSpecs.stakes: even the pause will become another event unless the timing table refuses to measure it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: lets two named people at a track meet timing table uncover the lesson through exchange

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who expects beauty to prove itself through a clean behavior metric
exampleSpecs.stakes: a school office may reject the image as useless if the only expected result is fewer tardies
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: sets up a metric expectation at a school attendance office, then reveals a softer outcome
